title: Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks
abstract: arXiv:2610.40394v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mathematical supervision for language models is typically flattened into isolated problem-solution pairs, discarding the curricular organization and evidential structure of the original sources. We introduce TOME-Math (Textbook-Oriented Mathematical Evidence), a large-scale corpus that converts 2,118 textbooks spanning the core areas of university-level mathematics subjects into approximately 380K structured proof-supervision records while preserving chapter order, proposition-proof links, dependency references, and source provenance. Leveraging these structural signals, we explore curriculum learning across multiple mathematical subjects and characterize scaling patterns with supervision volume and source breadth. translated_title: 从结构化教科书扩展数学证明监督
translated_abstract: 面向语言模型的数学监督数据通常被扁平化为孤立的问题-解答对，从而丢失了原始资料中的课程组织与证据结构。我们提出了TOME-Math（面向教科书的数学证据，Textbook-Oriented Mathematical Evidence），这是一个大规模语料库，将涵盖大学数学学科核心领域的2,118本教科书转换为约38万条结构化的证明监督记录，同时保留了章节顺序、命题-证明关联、依赖引用以及来源出处。利用这些结构信号，我们探索了跨多个数学学科的课程学习方法，并刻画了监督数据规模与来源广度带来的扩展规律。在完整规模下，基于TOME-Math进行微调，使模型在保留评估集及多个既有公开基准上的未加权平均得分比基础模型提升了16.7个百分点，同时超越了全部三个公开的指令微调模型。
tldr: 提出TOME-Math大规模语料库，将2,118本大学数学教科书转化为约38万条保留章节结构与证明依赖关系的结构化证明监督记录，微调后使模型在多项基准上平均提升16.7个百分点。
en_tdlr: TOME-Math converts 2,118 university mathematics textbooks into ~380K structured proof-supervision records that preserve curricular and evidential structure, improving fine-tuned model performance by 16.7 percentage points across evaluations and public benchmarks.
